source_text: A 2025 preprint meta-analysis reinforced protection specifically for PI-MSM (OR 0.57), supporting circumcision as a potential adjunctive strategy in this subgroup, but cautioned against broad extrapolation to all MSM given predominant receptive anal intercourse risks. [25]
